items.title: Fight simulation · bag
items.detail: 6 × 3 min at fight pace, 60s rest. Treat every round like it's scored. Hold 40+ punches/min to the final bell.

items.title: Technique · shadowboxing (head movement)
items.detail: 5 × 3 min with the camera coach, focused on head movement. Crisp, relaxed, perfect reps.

items.title: Fight-pace intervals · run
items.detail: 10 min easy, then 6 × 3 min hard / 60s walk, 10 min cool-down. Mirrors your fight's rounds.

items.title: Strength & power
items.detail: Trap-bar deadlift or squat 4×4, split squats 3×6, push-ups or bench 3×6, rows 3×8, rotational med-ball throws 4×5 each side, core. Leave 2 reps in the tank.
